bio.karatzis: Maths from the first year of middle school to advanced high school maths, backed by many years in the classroom. He starts from where the gap was left, not from today's chapter, and he has a gift for inspiring his students: they leave wanting to solve the problem, not just hand it in.
bio.manthaiaki: Language subjects from the first year of middle school to the national exams. With many years of teaching behind her and a structured method that simplifies even the most demanding material, she guides students step by step towards success. Her second specialisation in learning difficulties means that when a child struggles, the route changes rather than the goal.
bio.athanasaki: Language subjects, and the daily study sessions for primary school children. With deep affection and real dedication for teaching, she does not simply deliver material, she inspires. She builds an environment of genuine support and confidence, where every child unlocks what they are capable of, develops their critical thinking and gains the self belief they need to love learning.
bio.triamatakis: Maths for every year group. With a high scientific level and a rare gift for getting it across, he has a way of explaining difficult things in the plainest words: «as simple as possible, but not simpler». He unlocks how students think, answers every question patiently, and helps them believe in what they can do and come to love the subject.
bio.kallergi: Computer science, from the basic ideas to the exams. With a passion for technology and an organised method, she insists on a real understanding of the logic before the application, so a student can confidently solve even a problem they have not seen before. She develops analytical thinking and adapts the lesson to each child, leading them to success with confidence.

credentials.karatzis: BSc Applied Mathematics (University of Crete) | MSc Specific Learning Difficulties (University of Calabria)
credentials.manthaiaki: BA Philology (University of Crete) | MSc Classical Studies (University of Crete) | MSc Specific Learning Difficulties (University of Calabria)
credentials.athanasaki: BA Philology (University of Crete) | Specialisation in history
credentials.triamatakis: BSc Mathematics (University of Patras) | MSc Mathematics and Applications (University of Crete) | Doctoral candidate (Max Planck Institute)
credentials.kallergi: BSc and MSc Computer Science (University of Crete)

bioExtra.athanasaki: For her, philology is far more than an academic subject; it is a field that keeps inspiring her and moving her forward. With a love for education and for teaching, her aim is to pass on knowledge in a way that is substantial and creative, building critical thinking, confidence and a love of learning in her students. She believes every student can grow when they feel supported, inspired and encouraged to discover what they are capable of. She also runs the study centre, where primary school children study every day and leave with the next day's homework done.

About.title: About us
About.intro: Two teachers who opened their own school in Venerato, and a team that grew around them.
About.storyOne: «Peri Paideias» was created by Vasilis Karatzis and Maria Manthaiaki, after many years of teaching in classrooms and one to one.
About.storyTwo: Through daily contact with students and families we understood something simple: supporting a child does not stop at the syllabus. It needs a space they come to gladly, a schedule that holds, and someone who notices that something is wrong before the grade says so.
About.storyThree: So we built a school with small groups, one that supports children from their first steps in primary school to the «marathon» of the national exams.
About.teamIntro: A student knows who is in front of them, and we know what each of us is doing.

Activities.title: Activities and events
Activities.intro: Learning does not stop at the board. Conferences, talks and trips bring the theory to life and widen what our students see.
Activities.outdoorIntro: Learning is not confined to the four walls of a classroom. Every year we run something different, from trips and escape rooms to themed evenings, team games and cinema nights.
Activities.outdoorClosing: That gives our students a break from the daily studying, makes us stronger as a group, and creates memories that stay with them for good.

psychologist.title: Psychologist's talk on anxiety
psychologist.text: At our school, preparing for success is not only about the syllabus, it is also about our students' emotional resilience. That is why our psychologist takes a standing part in what we do, through talks and through sessions.

careerGuidance.title: Careers advisor
careerGuidance.text: We believe that success in the exams is the result of a clear goal. That is why career guidance is one of our standing annual activities, giving our students the tools to discover what they are drawn to and to plan their academic and professional future with confidence.

sifmeni.text: As a member of the association of secondary tutoring school owners of Heraklion, our school takes part every year in the association's annual conference on careers guidance, where our students get the chance to meet professionals and academics.
